english.title: Cause unmanned vehicle to enter etc a prohibited place for a purpose prejudicial to the UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused an unmanned vehicle or device, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE OR DEVICE..), to

(A)_[access]_
(B)_[enter]_
(C)_[inspect]_
(D)_[pass over]_
(E)_[pass under]_
(F)_[approach or be in the vicinity of]_

a prohibited place, namely **(..SPECIFY PROHIBITED PLACE..), when you knew, or having regard to other matters known to you, ought to have known, that the conduct was for a purpose that was prejudicial to the safety or interests of the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1)(a)(ii), (b) and (5) of the National Security Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, section 37 of the National Security Act 2023.
(ii) For the purpose of the offence, a person can access, enter, inspect, pass over/under, approach, or be in the vicinity of a prohibited place by electronic or remote means, section 4(3).
(iii) This offence applies whether the person's conduct takes place in the UK or elsewhere, section 4(4).
(iv) For offending under this section committed otherwise than via an unmanned vehicle or device, see H101395.
(v) Additional powers of entry, search and seizure are provided in Schedule 2 where there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that this offence has been, or is about to be, committed.

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 14 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
